verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 'Change history' for flags, which tracks flag configuration changes, and community mentions of Slack integration for visibility into changes corroborates change tracking exists; however, no evidence explicitly confirms a full audit log capturing who/when/old-value/new-value in a governance-focused, exportable/immutable format. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of audit-log fields (actor, timestamp, before/after value), retention/export/SIEM integration details, and independent confirmation of completeness.
